title: tc-agent-fleet
description: Several top-level agents side by side – each card sums up its sub-agents; a click opens its tree beside it.

agents.description: The top-level agents, each with its sub-agents nested in `children`

open.description: The id of the agent whose tree is open, or null. Changed by the cards unless tc-open-change is prevented

now.description: The clock for running times, in epoch ms – unset uses an internal clock

task.description: What it was asked to do

tools.description: Marks of the tools it works with (cloned) – shown as small overlapping tiles

cost.description: Its own cost so far – the children's costs are added on top

ask.description: What it waits for you to decide – shown when you open "needs you"

error.description: What went wrong – shown when you open "failed"

started.description: When it started and ended (ms) – for the time it took
